label: Social hall and kiddush space
description: Kiddush is too crowded, loud or uncomfortable; a bigger social hall and room to gather.

label: Hosting simchas at the shul
description: Wanting to hold bar and bat mitzvahs and other simchas at Darchei Noam, and space for events.

label: Sanctuary seating and size
description: Seats and room in the Main Sanctuary, especially on simcha Shabbatot.

label: The Annex and 8:15 minyan
description: Space, seating and the women's section in the Annex.

label: Women's section
description: Space, visibility, acoustics and the mechitza.

label: Youth, groups and young families
description: Group rooms, Tot Shabbat, play space and room for kids and parents.

label: Safety, accessibility and flow
description: Stairs and split levels, wheelchair access, exits, hallway and coat room congestion, and kids outside near the road.

label: Noise and decorum during davening
description: Hallway noise, talking and kids running around during davening, and the feel of the space.

label: Beit midrash and learning space
description: A dedicated room for learning and the weekday minyan.

label: Comfort and amenities
description: Seating, temperature, a nursing room, stroller parking, cubbies and similar.

label: More space in general
description: Calls for more room without naming one space.

label: Think bigger and plan for growth
description: Build for future growth, consider other properties, avoid a half measure.

label: Keep it right-sized
description: Don't overbuild; focus on the spaces that are too small and keep the shul's feel.

label: Transparency, plans and updates
description: Share the plans, budget, timeline, progress and these results, with regular updates.

label: Affordability and pressure to give
description: The ask feels too high or required, especially for renters, people saving for a home, seniors and single-income families.

label: Other ways to raise money
description: Dedications, events, donors and suggested donations instead of a flat ask.

label: Leadership and decision-making
description: Who is in charge, how decisions are made and how the rollout was handled.

label: Community life and inclusion
description: Feeling welcome, programming for people without kids, seniors and renters, and inclusion.

label: Thanks and support
description: Appreciation for the committee's work.

label: Other
description: Comments that don't fit a theme above.
